3510-3875-4875-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
3510-3875-4875-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

147-1070-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-6798.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2783-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

640-997-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

225-2557-3129-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-2557-3129-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

215-539-850-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with defender.
215-539-850-7781.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Overgrown Battlement
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

803-4529-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Bontu.
When God-Eternal Bontu dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Bontu's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Bontu.
As God-Eternal Bontu is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Bontu from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4659-5003-6554-7430.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
4659-5003-6554-7430.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

573-1558-2557-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-2557-3875-4231.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3948-7271.description: Maralen prevents players from drawing cards. The ability to search libraries will be rendered moot for opponents due to Stranglehold.

1661-2438-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-2438-4871-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

640-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
640-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

232-1235-2556-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Mnemonic Wall.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Mnemonic Wall with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Mnemonic Wall tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-2829-5089-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1170-1329-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2079-3101-3292-3892.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
2079-3101-3292-3892.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2079-3101-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

1238-1680-2351-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1395-1766-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Thran Dynamo.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4559-4740-5670-6753.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4559-4740-5670-6753.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

277-1479-5700-5701-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5700-5701-6662.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

1336-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
1336-4067-5672.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

372-1987-3277.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
372-1987-3277.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

997-2584-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Woe Strider is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

549-1365-2829-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-2829-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-2719.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-2719.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-2719.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2292-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-2292-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2757-4050-5081-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
2757-4050-5081-5434.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Obscuring Aether by paying {1}{G}, turning it face-down as a 2/2 creature.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Obscuring Aether, untapping the basic land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Obscuring Aether, adding {G}.
When Obscuring Aether dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down, then turning it face-up.
Repeat.

224-2366-3346-4875-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
"Mercenary" chosen with Conspiracy.
224-2366-3346-4875-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability from step 1, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Bog Glider.
Repeat.

567-1981-4435-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
567-1981-4435-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 50 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

643-3496-4071-4625.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-4881-5256.description:
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, causing target player to mill cards equal to Activated Sleeper's power.
Resolve the Activated Sleeper trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, targeting Activated Sleeper.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide, causing target player to mill cards equal to Karmic Guide's power.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

755-2869-5291.description:
Cast Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{R}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Kami of Industry with haste.
Put Cursed Mirror into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cursed Mirror's enters the battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Kami of Industry with haste.
Repeat from step 2.
